name: @sos-2/tests-real-observation
description: SOS 2.0 Real Observation + Product UX Wiring acceptance suites (Work Order P17-C). TWO suites, strictly separated. (1) DETERMINISTIC REFERENCE-MODE SUITE (default): no network, run-to-run identical — source→plane→System State contract compliance over scripted FetchPorts (event shapes, replay protection, the honest-state machine, no-body plane operation), consequential action wiring through the REAL merged action-gateway with authority gates (fail-closed on revoked/expired/never-held grants; idempotent replay; evidence emission), ASK resolution through the merged AskQueue, the live-mission view projections (LIVE provenance, retained uncertainty visible), the redaction-corpus alignment with the merged @sos-2/security patterns, and structural scans (zero ambient network/time/env in owned src outside the documented boundaries; imports restricted to merged + P17-C-owned packages). (2) REAL-PROVIDER INTEGRATION SUITE (RUN_REAL=1, default OFF): real GitHub events + CI polling with the PAT, real Vercel deployment events read directly, real runtime telemetry (GitHub rate-limit + Upstash Redis), real scheduled probes and the webhook receiver over real HTTP transport — honest outcomes recorded as JSON evidence with exact API revisions into docs/evidence/production-connectivity/observation-ux/.

scripts.test: pnpm run build && vitest run && node scripts/run-real-if-env.mjs
scripts.test:real: pnpm run build && vitest run --config vitest.real.config.ts
